note: Both sets capture the same core facts — 1:1 depth-to-height ratio, the Height = D*1.2 simplification, 0° window azimuth, truncated isosceles triangle louver shape, powder-coated finish, 25° structural bend, and 50° solar altitude at fall equinox 12pm — with quotes that support them. Set A adds three redundant duplicates of claims already present (depth-to-height ratio, louver shape, 25° bend), making it more repetitive without adding information. Set B has one fewer duplicate but truncates a condition field ('along the louver longit'), a minor misread; net defects are essentially equal, and both omit the proportional spacing reduction based on average profile widths.
